name: Required converter
description: Run with the sample started as --RequiredConverters:application/pdf=PDFium, on the office printer's spooler or CUPS queue and on its IPP channel. The job names no converter, yet the required one renders it on every channel: the log says Rendered by PDFium, and the placement applies instead of being dropped. One one-sided sheet a channel; print it on the back of a spare sheet.

jobs.description: page 1 at its own size, against the top left corner, rendered by the required PDFium on every channel, Placement not dropped
